name: smartwatch-pay
description: Smartwatch payments with Nequi and Wompi: NestJS backend, Expo companion app and Wear OS app

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/backend install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install && npm --prefix apps/watch/wearos install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/backend run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/watch/wearos run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run backend:test
